new_en: You swim to the side of the pool and turn around. Mason kneels and cuts through your bindings. "There. I hope another student didn't do this to you." <<He>> steps away.
"N-no," you say. "I should stay tied up."
"Did I ask for help?" you say, glaring at the teacher.
Mason looks confused. "If you're sure. I don't think there's a rule forbidding bound <<= pcAreArmsBound("any") ? "arm" : "limb">>s while swimming. Just be careful, okay?"
